# Setup

This notebook turns the four cached fits of notebook 3.2 into the estimands, and saves them as one small file of posterior draws.
Anything that shows results (the HMS deck, later the manuscript) reads that file instead of the fits, so it renders in seconds.

- Input: the full fits `data/04_models/{games,thermo}_{bb,gauss}.rds` (git-ignored). Nothing is refitted here. If a fit is missing, the notebook stops.
- Output: `data/05_results/eu25_ap_post.rds`.

The estimands are those of 3.2 (*Estimand*): $AP_t = E(Y \mid Co, t) - E(Y \mid Out, t)$, $\Delta AP = AP_{\text{explicit}} - AP_{\text{vote-anchored}}$, and the cross-measure difference $\Delta AP^{SD}_{\text{thermo}} - \Delta AP^{SD}_{\text{games}}$.
They are computed for the pooled support and for each country, and every quantity is reported with its posterior median, 95% and 99% intervals and $\Pr(> 0)$.

**Nothing in this notebook is a claim.** The estimates are reported with their uncertainty and not interpreted here.

```{r}
#| label: setup

# To track render duration
start_time <- Sys.time()

# set width of console output
options(width = 80)


# Install and load required packages
p_required <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "here",
  "brms",
  "cmdstanr",
  "posterior",
  "sessioninfo"
)
packages <- rownames(installed.packages())
p_to_install <- p_required[!(p_required %in% packages)]
if (length(p_to_install) > 0) {
  install.packages(p_to_install)
}
sapply(p_required, require, character.only = TRUE)
rm(p_required, p_to_install, packages)

# Same seed as 3.2, so the same posterior draws are used
seed <- 2019
ndraws_post <- 1000
max_treedepth <- 10

model_dir <- here("data", "04_models")
out_dir <- here("data", "05_results")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

fit_files <- file.path(
  model_dir,
  c("games_bb.rds", "games_gauss.rds", "thermo_bb.rds", "thermo_gauss.rds")
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(fit_files)))
```

# Data

The estimation data are rebuilt exactly as in notebook 3.2 (*Data*: *Games*, *Thermometer*, *Common Support*).
**This code must stay identical to 3.2**: the fits were estimated on these rows, and the estimands average over them.
Only the lines the estimands need are kept; the tables and figures stay in 3.2.

```{r}
#| label: data

eu25_games <- read_rds(here("data", "03_final", "eu25_games.rds"))
eu25_thermo <- read_rds(here("data", "03_final", "eu25_thermo.rds"))

# Games, as in 3.2 (games-sample)
games <- eu25_games |>
  filter(
    type %in% c("explicit", "vote_anchored"),
    der_cj_partisan_relationship %in% c("co", "out")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    der_explicit = as.integer(type == "explicit"),
    der_co = as.integer(der_cj_partisan_relationship == "co"),
    der_trust = as.integer(game == "trust"),
    der_wave3 = as.integer(wave == 3),
    der_cell = paste(type, der_cj_partisan_relationship),
    der_anchor = paste(country, anchor, sep = ": "),
    round = factor(round),
    across(c(cj_age, cj_sex, cj_rel, cj_class, der_cj_eu_identity), factor)
  ) |>
  mutate(der_w = 1 / n(), .by = meta_responseid)

games_scale <- list(mean = mean(games$cj_pl2), sd = sd(games$cj_pl2))
games <- games |>
  mutate(der_y_z = (cj_pl2 - games_scale$mean) / games_scale$sd)

# Thermometer, as in 3.2 (thermo-sample)
thermo <- eu25_thermo |>
  filter(
    type %in% c("explicit", "vote_anchored"),
    der_thermo_relationship %in% c("co", "out")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    der_explicit = as.integer(type == "explicit"),
    der_co = as.integer(der_thermo_relationship == "co"),
    der_wave3 = as.integer(wave == 3),
    der_cell = paste(type, der_thermo_relationship),
    der_anchor = paste(country, anchor, sep = ": ")
  ) |>
  mutate(der_w = 1 / n(), .by = meta_responseid)

thermo_scale <- list(mean = mean(thermo$q_thermo), sd = sd(thermo$q_thermo))
thermo <- thermo |>
  mutate(der_y_z = (q_thermo - thermo_scale$mean) / thermo_scale$sd)

# Common support, as in 3.2 (games-support, thermo-support)
add_support <- function(df) {
  support <- df |>
    distinct(der_anchor, meta_responseid, type) |>
    count(der_anchor, type) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    filter(explicit >= 1, vote_anchored >= 1)
  mutate(df, der_support = der_anchor %in% support$der_anchor)
}
games <- add_support(games)
thermo <- add_support(thermo)

# Sample sizes, for the slides
n_info <- bind_rows(games = games, thermo = thermo, .id = "measure") |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    respondent_waves = n_distinct(meta_responseid),
    persons = n_distinct(meta_pid),
    anchors = n_distinct(der_anchor),
    anchors_support = n_distinct(der_anchor[der_support]),
    rows_support = sum(der_support),
    .by = measure
  )
n_info
```

# Estimand Code

The cell means follow `ap_draws()` of 3.2, with one change for speed.
3.2 calls it three times per model (pooled, by country, by party), and each call runs `posterior_epred()` over all rows in four counterfactual cells.
Here it runs **once per model, by country**, and returns each country's weighted *sums* and weight totals instead of means.
Country means are sums over weights. The pooled mean is the sum over all countries divided by the total weight, which is exactly the respondent-weighted pooled mean of 3.2.
The draws are the same as in 3.2: `set.seed(seed)` and then 1,000 of the 4,000 draws, as `ap_draws()` does.

```{r}
#| label: estimand-code

# Weighted sums of the predicted outcome per country, per cell and draw
cell_sums <- function(fit, data, ids, back = identity, chunk = 5000) {
  grp <- factor(data$country)
  m <- sapply(levels(grp), \(l) (grp == l) * data$der_w)
  m <- matrix(m, nrow = nrow(data), dimnames = list(NULL, levels(grp)))
  rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(data)) / chunk))

  cells <- expand_grid(der_explicit = 0:1, der_co = 0:1)
  sums <- map2(cells$der_explicit, cells$der_co, \(e, k) {
    nd <- mutate(data, der_explicit = e, der_co = k)
    tot <- 0
    for (i in rows) {
      ep <- back(posterior_epred(fit, newdata = nd[i, ], draw_ids = ids))
      tot <- tot + ep %*% m[i, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    tot
  })
  names(sums) <- paste0("m", cells$der_explicit, "_", cells$der_co)
  list(sums = sums, w = colSums(m))
}

# Cell means by draw: countries and pooled
cell_means <- function(cs) {
  map(cs$sums, \(tot) {
    by_country <- sweep(tot, 2, cs$w, "/")
    pooled <- rowSums(tot) / sum(cs$w)
    cbind(pooled = pooled, by_country)
  })
}

# AP by type and Delta AP by draw, raw and in SD units
ap_contrasts <- function(means, sd_y, ids) {
  long <- imap(means, \(mat, cell) {
    as_tibble(mat) |>
      mutate(.draw = ids) |>
      pivot_longer(-.draw, names_to = "group", values_to = cell)
  }) |>
    reduce(inner_join, by = c(".draw", "group"))

  long |>
    transmute(
      .draw,
      group,
      ap_vote_anchored = m0_1 - m0_0,
      ap_explicit = m1_1 - m1_0,
      delta_ap = ap_explicit - ap_vote_anchored,
      ap_vote_anchored_sd = ap_vote_anchored / sd_y,
      ap_explicit_sd = ap_explicit / sd_y,
      delta_ap_sd = delta_ap / sd_y
    )
}

# Median, 95% and 99% intervals, Pr(> 0)
summarise_post <- function(df, ...) {
  df |>
    summarise(
      median = median(value),
      lower_95 = quantile(value, 0.025),
      upper_95 = quantile(value, 0.975),
      lower_99 = quantile(value, 0.005),
      upper_99 = quantile(value, 0.995),
      p_positive = mean(value > 0),
      .by = c(...)
    )
}

# MCMC diagnostics, as in 3.2
mcmc_check <- function(fit) {
  s <- withCallingHandlers(
    summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit), "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"),
    warning = \(w) {
      if (grepl("ESS has been capped", conditionMessage(w))) {
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    }
  )
  np <- nuts_params(fit)
  tibble(
    max_rhat = max(s$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergent = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
    max_treedepth = sum(
      np$Value[np$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= max_treedepth
    )
  )
}
```

# Posterior Computation

The models are loaded and processed one at a time, and each fit is dropped from memory before the next is loaded (about 560 MB each).
The Gaussian models are fitted on the z-scored outcome, so their predictions are back-transformed to tokens and points before averaging, as in 3.2.

```{r}
#| label: post

specs <- tribble(
  ~name,          ~measure, ~model,  ~data,  ~scale,
  "games_bb",     "games",  "bb",    "games",  "games",
  "games_gauss",  "games",  "gauss", "games",  "games",
  "thermo_bb",    "thermo", "bb",    "thermo", "thermo",
  "thermo_gauss", "thermo", "gauss", "thermo", "thermo"
)
datasets <- list(games = games, thermo = thermo)
scales <- list(games = games_scale, thermo = thermo_scale)

post <- pmap(specs, \(name, measure, model, data, scale) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  fit <- read_rds(file.path(model_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))

  set.seed(seed)
  ids <- sample(seq_len(ndraws(fit)), min(ndraws_post, ndraws(fit)))

  sc <- scales[[scale]]
  back <- if (model == "gauss") \(x) x * sc$sd + sc$mean else identity

  cs <- cell_sums(fit, filter(datasets[[data]], der_support), ids, back)
  contrasts <- ap_contrasts(cell_means(cs), sc$sd, ids) |>
    mutate(model = model, measure = measure, .before = 1)
  diag <- mcmc_check(fit) |>
    mutate(name = name, .before = 1)

  rm(fit)
  gc()
  message(name, ": ", round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "mins"), 1), " min")
  list(contrasts = contrasts, diag = diag)
})

contrasts <- map(post, "contrasts") |> bind_rows()
diagnostics <- map(post, "diag") |> bind_rows()
diagnostics |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Cross-Measure Difference

$\Delta AP^{SD}_{\text{thermo}} - \Delta AP^{SD}_{\text{games}}$, per model and group.
The two measures were fitted separately, so draws are paired by index, as in 3.2. With the same seed, both use the same draw positions.

```{r}
#| label: cross

cross <- contrasts |>
  select(model, measure, group, .draw, delta_ap_sd) |>
  mutate(i = row_number(), .by = c(model, measure, group)) |>
  select(-.draw) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = delta_ap_sd) |>
  transmute(model, group, i, diff = thermo - games)

stopifnot(!anyNA(cross$diff))
```

## Check Against 3.2

The pooled beta-binomial estimates must reproduce the pooled tables printed by 3.2 (same draws, same rows, same weights).
The 3.2 values are copied from its rendered output.

```{r}
#| label: check-32

ref_32 <- tribble(
  ~model, ~measure, ~quantity,     ~median_32,
  "bb",   "games",  "delta_ap",    0.37,
  "bb",   "games",  "delta_ap_sd", 0.15,
  "bb",   "thermo", "delta_ap",    20.74,
  "bb",   "thermo", "delta_ap_sd", 0.66
)

check <- contrasts |>
  filter(group == "pooled") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(model, measure, .draw, group), names_to = "quantity") |>
  summarise(median = median(value), .by = c(model, measure, quantity)) |>
  inner_join(ref_32, by = c("model", "measure", "quantity"))
check

stopifnot(all(abs(check$median - check$median_32) < 0.011 * pmax(1, abs(check$median_32))))
```

# Summaries

Pooled estimates for both models.

```{r}
#| label: summary-pooled

contrasts |>
  filter(group == "pooled") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(model, measure, .draw, group), names_to = "quantity") |>
  summarise_post(model, measure, quantity) |>
  arrange(model, measure, quantity) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

cross |>
  filter(group == "pooled") |>
  rename(value = diff) |>
  summarise_post(model) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

By country, beta-binomial: $\Delta AP^{SD}$ per measure and the cross-measure difference.

```{r}
#| label: summary-country

contrasts |>
  filter(model == "bb", group != "pooled") |>
  select(measure, group, value = delta_ap_sd) |>
  summarise_post(measure, group) |>
  select(measure, group, median, lower_95, upper_95, p_positive) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = c(median, lower_95, upper_95, p_positive)
  ) |>
  arrange(group) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

cross |>
  filter(model == "bb", group != "pooled") |>
  rename(value = diff) |>
  summarise_post(group) |>
  arrange(group) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

# Save

One list, small enough to track in git:

- `draws`: posterior draws of all quantities, long (`model`, `measure`, `group`, `.draw`, `quantity`, `value`);
- `cross`: the paired cross-measure difference (`model`, `group`, `i`, `diff`);
- `scales`: outcome mean and SD per measure, for back-translating SD units;
- `diagnostics`: MCMC diagnostics per fit;
- `n`: sample sizes per measure.

```{r}
#| label: save

draws <- contrasts |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(model, measure, .draw, group),
    names_to = "quantity",
    values_to = "value"
  )

write_rds(
  list(
    draws = draws,
    cross = cross,
    scales = scales,
    diagnostics = diagnostics,
    n = n_info
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "eu25_ap_post.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)

file.size(file.path(out_dir, "eu25_ap_post.rds")) / 1e6
```
